```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

Body text before. The chunk below deliberately sets neither `tbl-cap` nor
`apa-note`. This is the fixture for the clipped-column regression -- a
multi-block `apa.reg.table()`, the widest builder output in
the suite, whose R-squared / Delta-R-squared columns and their confidence
intervals were the ones flextable's fixed-inch table silently clipped from a
rendered `.docx` with no warning and exit 0.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-widereg
#| echo: false
blk1 <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay, data = album)
blk2 <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay + attract, data = album)
apa.quarto.docx(apa.reg.table(blk1, blk2, table.number = 9))
```

Body text after, ENDMARKER.
